posts.title: ●CERAMIC RELIEF● BLOOM TO THE FUTURE
posts.description: Otomo has designed a ceramic relief that was installed today at the entrance of the Sanuma High School ( 佐沼高校 ) building in Tome City, Miyagi Prefecture. Where he studied when he was a teenager in the sixties. Otomo attended the inauguration ceremony and gave a short speech. The centennial High school's main building underwent reconstruction due to the aging of its former facilities and the work was completed last September. FNN's coverage Otomo's comments Flowers come in all sizes—some are large, some are small, and some bloom quietly deep within a forest. I created this design with the hope that, someday, each of you will bloom in your own way, wherever you may be.

posts.title: ●INTERVIEW● TEZUKA! GOD OF MANGA special preview clips 3 & 5
posts.description: Tezuka Productions has released the third and the fifth special preview interview clips with Katsuhiro Otomo for the upcoming feature-length documentary that celebrates Osamu Tezuka’s life and legacy: TEZUKA! GOD OF MANGA. The film is being funded by a Kickstarter campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tezuka/tezuka-god-of-manga Otomo's comments When the Astro Boy anime first aired on TV, I don't remember if it was Meiji or Morinaga, but one of the Japanese candy makers sponsored the show. Later, Glico sponsored "Tetsujin 28 Go" and "8 Man" was sponsored by Marumiya's furikake. So animated manga programs always had these kind of sponsors. So these sponsors, in order to sell more chocolate would put stickers with the manga characters inside the chocolate bars and it was really popular with kids to collect those stickers. posts.title: ●BOOKLET● ŌTOMO KATSUHIRO ZENSHŪ KAISETSU 23 Animation AKIRA Layouts & Key Frames 1 (大友克洋全集解説 23 Animation AKIRA Layouts & Key Frames 1)
posts.description: Independent Katsuhiro Otomo researcher and archivist Jun'ya Suzuki (鈴木淳也), who in 1999 started the website Apple Paradise: Otomo Katsuhiro Data Base h as published the fourteenth book of a series of booklets to accompany the KATSUHIRO OTOMO COMPLETE WORKS collection that is currently being published by Kodansha. This booklet is a long table of content of the materials collected in the book OTOMO THE COMPLETE WORKS 23 Layouts and keyframes 1 . These COMMENTARY SERIES booklets scheduled to be produced for all volumes also work perfectly as dividers of the complete works volumes, since they prevent vinyl covers from sticking to each other. The booklet was sold for the first time today at at COMITIA 157 (コミティア157) in the stand Nishi 2X 40b LITERATEX SHŪSHŪ-KA (西2 Ｘ40b リテラテックス蒐集課) . You can follow and contact Jun'ya Suzuki on Instagram and X to get the book.
